friendly_name: Read-Side Seam: Honest Census and Kind-Blind Resolver Closure
purpose_context: A follow-up issue claimed a particular lookup helper was unguarded and needed ~39 call sites changed. An adversarial review of the live code disproved that: the helper is already guarded by a different check, and every one of those sites is already correct. The real gap is a sibling helper nobody guards, which can hand a caller an empty coordination directory instead of the real one. This mission closes that genuine gap, closes two small related residuals, and corrects the misleading records that manufactured the wrong follow-up in the first place.
purpose_tldr: Correct the read-seam's own record and police the resolver that genuinely has no guard, instead of the one an issue mis-identified.
